Columns in order: BNHS 3574 (holotype, male), BNHS 3575, NCBS BH655, NCBS BH656, Range, Mean; Sex row as printed: '♂ ♀ ♂ ♂' (male, female, male, male). The quote is the whole ED row, which prints all four specimen values, then the range 2.7-3.6 and the mean 3.25; this record is the NCBS BH656 column. Type material as printed: Holotype 'INDIA • ♂ adult; Arunachal Pradesh, Lohit District, outskirts of Kamlang Wildlife Sanctuary, found along the road leading to Hawa camp from Parshuram Kund; 27.880711° N, 96.363239° E; 350 m a.s.l. (Datum WGS84); 23 Jul. 2019; Harshal Bhosale, Mandar Savant, Pushkar Phansalkar and Gaurang Gowande leg.; BNHS 3574.' Paratypes 'INDIA • 1 ♀; same collection data as for holotype; BNHS 3575 • 2 ♂♂; same collection data as for holotype; 28 Jul. 2019; Zeeshan Mirza, Harshal Bhosale, Mandar Savant, Pushkar Phansalkar and Gaurang Gowande leg.; NCBS BH655–BH656.' No age is printed for the paratypes. The holotype column (BNHS 3574, Table 1 ED 3.5) is not logged: the Description of the holotype prints 'Eye large, circular, 3.13 mm (eye diameter/head height 0.48) diameter', which disagrees with the Table 1 cell, and the discrepancy is unresolved.

note: new trait: eye_diameter_mm (same key as main). Row and column mapping as returned by the page reader from the EJT PDF text, which warned that the table layout is jumbled in extraction (two separate reads gave the same ED order 3.5, 3.6, 2.7, 3.2; the range 2.7-3.6 and mean 3.25 are consistent with those four values and the SVL row 550, 484, 455, 545 fits the same column order). Licence sentence on the copy read: 'This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0).' Byline as printed (reader text): Harshal Bhosale, Pushkar Phansalkar, Mandar Sawant, Gaurang Gowande, Harshil Patel, Zeeshan A. Mirza; European Journal of Taxonomy 729: 54-73 (2020); DOI 10.5852/ejt.2020.729.1191. Species validity: Reptile Database page for Pareas kaduri opened from a search result: Pareidae; authority 'Bhosale, Phansalkar, Sawant, Gowande, Patel & Mirza, 2020'; the page lists the 2022 combination Pareas (Eberhardtia) kaduri among synonyms and prints no explicit 'valid'. Not on main (git grep of kaduri and the DOI over docs/ on origin/main 33d27bc4d: no hit). Printed heading path (no colons printed): Class Reptilia Laurenti, 1768 / Order Squamata Oppel, 1811 / Suborder Serpentes Linnaeus, 1758 / Family Pareidae Romer, 1956 / Subfamily Pareinae Romer, 1956 / Genus Pareas Wagler, 1830 / Pareas kaduri sp. nov.. Eye-size passage: Material and methods print 'Measurements were taken with the help of a digital calliper to the nearest 0.1 mm, except SVL and TaL, which were taken with a string and then measured using a scale.' and, in the Abbreviations list after the Morphology subsection, 'ED = eye diameter, widest diameter of the eye'; Table 1 prints no unit, so mm comes from the calliper sentence. Holotype description: 'Eye large, circular, 3.13 mm (eye diameter/head height 0.48) diameter with a spherical pupil.' Auditor 1245 read Table 1 in two passes of the EJT text and got the same column order both times: header 'BNHS 3574 BNHS 3575 NCBS BH655 NCBS BH656 Range Mean', 'Sex ♂ ♀ ♂ ♂ – –', 'SVL 550 484 455 545 455–550 508.5', 'ED 3.5 3.6 2.7 3.2 2.7–3.6 3.25'. The ED row's range and mean agree with its four cells, but two other rows as read do not (HW 8.8, 6.8, 7.1, 7.9 with range 7.1–8.8 and mean 7.3625; HL mean 12.8125 against 12.65 from the four cells, my arithmetic), so the table carries typographic slips elsewhere; with the holotype 3.13 against 3.5 conflict this is a reason for caution on the cells.
